thread:
maya: quick design review — the latest capacity card feels very dense on 1280w. we have min/max steppers, burst toggle, pool selector, slo slider, and a live cost badge all visible. i'm worried about scanability and keyboard flow. idea: default to a 'condensed' state where burst details live in a popover and pool preview is a single-line chip, expand on click. also aria concerns for the SLO slider aria-label+value announcements.
jordan: i like condense-by-default for power users, but new users might miss burst. suggestion: persist state per user and add a subtle "expanded" hint on first-run (toast). screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/ux/capacity-card-dense.png :eyes:
liam: engineering note — persisting per-user state is fine. popover focus trap will add some complexity (we need to ensure esc returns focus to the burst toggle). aria-wise we can use aria-haspopup and aria-expanded on the toggle and aria-describedby linking to the popover content.
sophia: product preference: default expanded for trial accounts, condensed for heavy accounts. we can flip based on a simple usage heuristic (requests/day > X). also need copy: change "Burst" to "Burst capacity (temporary)" and add a microcopy line under min/max: "Min/Max are soft targets; autoscale may exceed during bursts".
maya: microcopy tweak sounds good. also slider should show the numeric SLO next to the handle on drag and an accessible readout for screen readers. tiny nit: pool selector tooltip should show GPU type, region, and estimated median latency.
jordan: accessibility nit — slider track contrast is borderline. bump to 4.5:1 on the filled track. bump stepper button hit target to 40px min and add aria-labels like "increase min instances" and "decrease max instances". keyboard order: min -> max -> burst -> pool -> slo.
alex: small implementation suggestion: keep DOM order as visual order but use tabindex="0" on interactive elements and keyboard handlers for Enter/Space on the burst toggle. tiny CSS hint we used elsewhere:
```
.card .stepper button { min-width:40px; min-height:40px; }
.slo-slider[aria-valuenow]::after { content: attr(aria-valuenow) 'ms'; position:absolute; }
```
liam: locale strings: make sure the microcopy lines are short — localization teams flagged multi-clause sentences. suggest limit to 50 chars for badge copy.
maya: action items: jordan to mock condensed vs expanded states, jordan please add accessible annotations in the figma file; alex to add keyboard behavior snippet to the dev notes; liam to scope focus trap work and add an estimate; sophia to confirm usage threshold for user heuristic. i'll file a small UX ticket for copy updates.
design-bot: created ticket <https://redwood.app/t/RED-4521|RED-4521> "Capacity card: condensed mode, aria fixes, keyboard flow" :white_check_mark:
jordan: i'll post two mock variations by EOD and include a11y checklist. :thumbsup:
maya: thanks — feel free to @me in the designs when ready.
